analysis.revision_reason: The original assessment incorrectly criticizes the use of 'dia(above, bread)' and 'dia(below, bread)' as incorrect modal logic relations when the requirement only concerns syntactic well-formedness. The requirement does not specify that 'oneabove' and 'onebelow' are the only valid relations, so the assessment imposes an unstated exclusivity condition.
